text:
alex: Heads-up — after the arch-detect toggle merged yesterday I'm seeing a 15-25% p99 latency regression on FP8 for our chat workload when KV cache misses happen. Seems to only hit mixed short prefixes (<=64) and high concurrency. Perf traces attached below.

maria: Can you paste the top profiler flame or perf output? Is it CUTLASS or Triton path that's slower?

alex: perf-bot: summary attached
perf-bot: Kernel selection: cutlass_fp8_gemm_sparse_fast (selected)
perf-bot: Fallback path: triton_fp8_gemm (not selected)
perf-bot: p99 increased from 42ms -> 53ms for token generation on A100 with 1k concurrency, KV miss rate ~18%

alex: Snippet from run:
```
[2026-03-15T11:02:12Z] arch_probe -> reported arch=sm_80 (A100)
[2026-03-15T11:02:12Z] build_flags -> CUTLASS_FAST_MATH=1, FP8_KERNEL=enabled
[2026-03-15T11:02:12Z] kernel_route -> selected=cutlass_fp8_gemm_sparse_fast, heuristic_score=0.78
[2026-03-15T11:02:13Z] kv_cache -> miss -> path=short-prefix (len=32) -> batch_split=4
[2026-03-15T11:02:13Z] latency -> token_gen=53ms (prev=42ms)
```

ryan: Hm. Could be arch_probe misclassifying some H100-like configs as sm_80 -> selects a cutlass kernel tuned for A100 that has lower perf on small GEMMs. Any failures in nvml/rocm probe logs?

alex: No obvious nvml errors. But I do see `hwcap` mapping send H100 microcode to sm_80 in a few hosts after the toggle. Might be the arch-detection table ordering.

maria: Another angle — batching heuristics changed recently too (prefix-aware split). If batch_split increases, we shrink GEMM dims; CUTLASS kernel we pick might be throughput-optimized for large tiles and lose on tiny N/K. Try forcing our small-gemm-optimized kernel and see.

jen: Quick test idea: run microbench against representative shapes (M=512,K=128,N=48) with both kernels. Use env toggles: CUTLASS_FORCE_KERNEL=small_tile and CUTLASS_DISABLE_FAST_MATH=1. Also try triton path: TRITON_FORCE_FP8=1.

alex: Ran microbench locally. Results:
```
shape M512xN48xK128
cutlass_fast: 0.82 ms/op
cutlass_small_tile: 0.47 ms/op
triton_fp8: 0.51 ms/op
```
So small_tile wins on the small shapes. That aligns with latency regression.

ryan: So root cause likely heuristic+arch mapping causing wrong kernel preference for small GEMMs when KV misses force short prefixes. We need two fixes: 1) tweak arch-detect ordering for H100-like hosts. 2) update selection heuristic to consider expected GEMM size distribution (hot prefix vs cold).

maria: Agreed. Also we should add a calibration step in the runtime: sample a few shapes at start-of-epoch and bias kernel scores accordingly (cheap microbench). That avoids large rollouts causing perf cliffs.

alex: I've created a minimal repro script and uploaded to the infra bench job. Job id: bench/20260315-18. Logs say worker 07 reported arch=sm_90 but runtime applied sm_80 rule.

infra-bot: bench/20260315-18 started, 10 runs queued. Link: https://ci.redwood/foo/bench/20260315-18

jen: For short-term mitigation, can we change the default policy to prefer triton_fp8 for batch_split >= 3? That should reduce customer impact while we patch selection logic.

ryan: +1. Also add a hotfix to disable CUTLASS_FAST_MATH on the offending pool — it's a single-line config change in deploy.

alex: I'll open a PR with two changes: arch-detect reorder + heuristic delta that penalizes kernels with tile_area > threshold when expected N < 64. PR draft: https://git/repo/pull/4092. Includes test harness.

maria: Nice. Can you also add an automated microbench in CI that runs a small set of shapes when building CUTLASS-enabled bundles? Prevents regressions.

alex: Yes. Action items:
- alex: PR for arch-detect + heuristic (WIP)
- jen: hotfix to config: prefer triton_fp8 for batch_split>=3 + disable CUTLASS_FAST_MATH on pool-7
- ryan: add CI microbench job + heuristic unit tests
- maria: follow-up to add runtime calibration sampling design doc

jen: I'll push config hotfix in next 15m and post here when deployed.

alex: thanks. I'll monitor the bench job and customer queues. Will post perf diffs after hotfix. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: bench/20260315-18 run 4/10 complete — small_tile win on 9/10 hosts, mean improvement 1.6x for target shapes.

alex: Good signal. Closing loop after deploy.
